info.title: Agora Interactive Conference Presentation API
info.description: OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification for Agora Cloudflare Worker, D1, R2, and Durable Object live session endpoints (SPEC-001 through SPEC-024).

tags.name: Presentations
tags.description: Presentation administration, revisions, and R2/D1 assets (SPEC-001, SPEC-017)

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: Live presentation sessions, Durable Object SQLite state, and navigation (SPEC-002, SPEC-003, SPEC-022)

tags.name: Questions
tags.description: Slide-scoped Q&A and idempotent upvoting (SPEC-006, SPEC-007)

tags.name: Interactions
tags.description: Emoji reactions, contextual polls, adaptive navigation, and word clouds

tags.name: Downloads
tags.description: Gated R2 PNG and PDF asset downloads (SPEC-014, SPEC-016, SPEC-024)

201.description: Created presentation with deterministic SHA-256 revisionHash

get.summary: Get presentation by ID with slides and revision status

put.summary: Update presentation, bump revision, and purge stale assets (SPEC-001)

patch.summary: Partially update presentation, bump revision, and purge stale assets (SPEC-001)

post.summary: Duplicate presentation without copying sessions or audience data (SPEC-017)
Upload slide PNG or deck PDF asset tied to presentation revision (SPEC-013, SPEC-015)

get.summary: List adaptive-navigation rules configured for a presentation (SPEC-011)

post.summary: Configure an adaptive branch rule for a presentation (SPEC-011)

delete.summary: Remove an adaptive branch rule from a presentation (SPEC-011)

404.description: Presentation or navigation rule not found

post.summary: Create a scheduled or live presentation session (SPEC-002)

201.description: Created session with presenterToken and QR code

get.summary: Fetch audience-safe session state (SPEC-002, SPEC-004, SPEC-005)

Anonymous attendee join returning session-scoped participant token (SPEC-002)
Navigate authoritative presenter slide and unlock PDF on ending slide (SPEC-003, SPEC-023)
Explicitly mark session as completed (SPEC-002, SPEC-022)

get.summary: List questions for session (optionally filtered by slideId, sorted by votes or time)

post.summary: Idempotently toggle participant upvote on a question (SPEC-007)

patch.summary: Update question status to pending, answered, or dismissed (SPEC-006)

post.summary: Submit emoji reaction for a revealed slide (SPEC-009)

get.summary: List polls accessible in a session (SPEC-010)
get.description: Unauthenticated responses include polls only for revealed slides; presenter credentials return all polls.

post.summary: Create and open a contextual slide poll (SPEC-010)
Submit participant vote in poll and evaluate adaptive navigation (SPEC-010, SPEC-011)
Close a poll and evaluate adaptive-navigation rules (SPEC-010, SPEC-011)

Create and open a word cloud prompt (SPEC-021)
Submit normalized term to word cloud (SPEC-021)
